description:
The 4StoreyBuilding.inp project is open in eQUEST. You are a BAS controls contractor tasked with implementing 'Optimum Start' logic to improve morning warm-up/cool-down efficiency. Currently, the building uses fixed start times which waste energy.

Your goal is to enable and configure Optimum Start on ALL 15 packaged single-zone (PSZ) HVAC systems (G.S*, M.S*, T.S*) in the building.

For EACH of the 15 systems, navigate to the Air-Side HVAC system properties and update the following control parameters:
1. Enable Optimum Start (`OPTIMUM-START` = YES)
2. Set Maximum Start Time (`OP-START-TIME`) to **3** hours
3. Set Heating Gradient (`HEAT-START-GRAD`) to **4.0** (degrees/hour)
4. Set Cooling Gradient (`COOL-START-GRAD`) to **3.5** (degrees/hour)

After updating all 15 systems (5 on Ground, 5 on Middle, 5 on Top floors), run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to validate the control sequence. Finally, save the project.
